goal.objective: Reconstruct and recover work after the prior worker stopped returning expected transition information to the single StegVerse heartbeat without reviving the ended claim or widening authority.
success_predicates: Prior lifecycle is reconstructed from durable checkpoint and Master Records evidence
Old worker instance authority remains ended
Any successor acquisition uses a separately authorized higher fencing generation
failure_predicates: Missing response is treated as a second heartbeat clock
Old claim or fence is reused

task.derivation_reason: Operational orphan recovery after the expected worker-response threshold was exceeded on the common heartbeat sequence; this is continuity recovery, not authority-bearing goal succession.

activation.recheck_trigger: each heartbeat after reconstruction and separate authorization are durable

completion.next_authorized_action: Produce a PASS reconstruction receipt bound to HB25-G20 and canonical Master Records evidence; only a separate authorization may then create a successor claim with fencing generation greater than 20.
terminal_when: Reconstruction receipt is durable and Master Records evidence is bound
Old claim and fence remain unusable
A separately authorized successor uses a higher fence or the work is safely terminated

block.recheck_trigger: each canonical heartbeat cycle; remain blocked until a hash-bound reconstruction receipt and separate higher-fence authorization are durable
block.escalation_condition: reconstruction evidence is contradictory, the old claim/fence appears live, or a successor attempts acquisition without a higher fence
